newsitem.title: USA: UPS adds new morning service to Europe.
newsitem.headline: UPS adds new morning service to Europe.

text.p: United Parcel Service of America Inc on Monday announced UPS Worldwide Express Plus, which guarantees second-day delivery from the United States to Europe by 0830 local time.

Beginning March 31, the Express Plus service will supplement the UPS Worldwide Express service that guarantees second-day delivery by 1030 and UPS Sonic Air for guaranteed international next-flight-out service.
UPS also offers next-day 0830 delivery on intra-European shipments and a 1030 next-day guarantee on inbound packages from major business centers worldwide.
